palette_rationale: Preserve reviewed white head/chest, blue source eye marks where native pixels survive, yellow beak/crest/feet, red wings, and dark feather tips from the Idle palette.
reference: Own DSTS chr706 model and clips; PMDO registry supplies engine action names, events and timing fields.
ground_policy_note: Reviewed grounded Idle and row-47 shadow. Walk uses foot contact; source-native one-shot lift is not flattened or supplemented.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Own stepping and wing-sway gait, loop endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Own wing-spread leap with visible source contact around 0.75s; never ground-trim Physical Attack.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Native wing/hand gather and forward release; no projectile or effect invented.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Own crouched rest, preserving source eye expression with no painted eyelids.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Own startled backward recoil with spread wings.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Native wing and body sweep, no synthetic weapon.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two visual cycles of own wing-leap Attack, one PMDO HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Own subtler crouch-and-rise with wing motion; no artificial vertical displacement.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Own braced charge pose with reverse-sampled recovery; no glow.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Own expression/pose motion with whole-view yaw; endpoint excluded.
